project_type: Cloudflare Workers SPA — vanilla JS frontend + Workers edge API
language: JavaScript (ES modules, no transpile step — files are served as-is)
build_system: GitHub Actions: node -e copies index.html + src/ + public/ → dist/, then wrangler deploy. No local build needed for development. wrangler.toml controls Workers config. Static assets served via env.ASSETS.fetch().
test_framework: node --test (no test files exist for frontend; syntax checks via node import)
test_command: node --input-type=module --eval "import('./worker/index.js').then(()=>console.log('OK')).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"  for worker syntax. For server.js: node -e "import('./server.js').then(()=>{setTimeout(()=>process.exit(0),1000)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
verification_instructions: 1. Run worker syntax check: node --input-type=module --eval "import('./worker/index.js')...". 2. Run server.js import check for main.js/style.css changes. 3. git push → watch GitHub Actions for green deploy. Production URL: https://lovell.bextercontact.workers.dev
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is generated by the GitHub Actions 'Prepare dist/' step (not checked in). Do not manually edit dist/.
environment_constraints: Cloudflare Workers runtime — no Node.js APIs, no filesystem. worker/index.js uses only Web APIs + import from lib/catalog-core.js. Do NOT restart any dev server. .env file must not be touched.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT touch: .env, node_modules/, dist/, src/data/offline-episodes.js. Keep all existing embed providers (vidrift, vidplus, vidy, vidsrc/buzz, vidrock, megaplay). Vanilla JS only — no frameworks. Cache-bust version in index.html ?v= query must increment when JS/CSS changes.
key_patterns: Worker: buildEmbeds(kind, id, alId, season, episode, opts) — uses add(id, name, url) helper, kind==='al' for anime, kind!=='al' for movie/tv. Frontend: $ / $$ jQuery-like helpers, store.get/set for localStorage, api() with internal cache, route() hash-router (#/izle, #/kesfet, #/filmler etc.), currentTab pattern needs to follow same store.get/set pattern as myList/progress. Embed player: mountEmbed(ctx, index) renders source-chip buttons from ctx.embeds array — array already filtered by worker, frontend just shows what arrives.
relevant_files: worker/index.js — buildEmbeds() function: add new providers here
src/main.js — currentTab state, setTab(), viewHome() filter, embed chip render
index.html — .tab-bar HTML insertion point, cache-bust version
directory_structure: root: index.html, package.json, wrangler.toml, server.js (local dev); src/: main.js, style.css, data/offline-episodes.js; worker/: index.js (Cloudflare Worker entry); lib/: catalog-core.js (TMDB+AniList API logic); public/: static assets (mark.svg etc.); dist/: generated, gitignored; .agents/tasks/: plan artifacts
